messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Paging integration 'pagerflow' failing to deliver pages to oncall group 'infra-ops' — 118 undelivered in last 5m. Error pattern: upstream 502 from notify-proxy. Auto-retries exhausted.

tess: seeing the same on our side, confirm 502s from notify-proxy logs. No obvious ratelimit spikes.

alex: I'm oncall — I didn't receive pages. I tried a manual page about 30s ago and nothing.

jordan: manual page to phone/call channel worked for me just now (so manual path ok). Service path (/v1/pages -> notify-proxy -> pagerflow) is the broken one. Sample logs:
```
2026-03-18T20:10:05Z ERROR notify-proxy upstream="10.8.2.43:502" request_id=abc123 path=/v1/pages status=502 body="Bad Gateway"
curl -X POST https://notify-proxy.redwood.internal/v1/pages -d '{"to":"infra-ops","msg":"test"}' -> 502
```

maria: was there a notify-proxy deploy recently? any config rollouts?

ops-bot: Deploy notice: notify-proxy service rolled (canary) at 2026-03-18T20:07:24Z by ci-cd; image: notify-proxy:v2.4.9.

tess: sounds like v2.4.9 regression. I'm going to: 1) flip traffic to notify-backup relay, 2) roll back notify-proxy to v2.4.8 on canary nodes, 3) open an incident page to track customer impact. Executing now.

alex: please @me when manual fallback is active so I can confirm pages.

jordan: running quick smoke: `./tools/send-test-page --target infra-ops --text "smoke"` to hit current relay.

ops-bot: Fallback relay set to notify-backup by tess at 2026-03-18T20:12:02Z.

alex: I just got the test page via fallback relay :thumbsup:.

tess: rolling back notify-proxy on canary now, command:
```shell
kubectl -n infra set image deploy/notify-proxy notify-proxy=notify-proxy:v2.4.8 --record
```
Rollback started.

jordan: customer-support reported one customer incident ticket where alerts were delayed ~11 minutes (ticket #CS-1429). They escalated to ops after missing pages.

tess: noted. That looks like customer-impact for a small subset (oncall pages to infra monitors). I'm marking P1-> P2 (customer-visible but partial). Adding that to incident tracking doc.

ops-bot: Rollback completed on canary at 2026-03-18T20:16:48Z. No further 502s observed in canary logs.

incident-bot: Monitoring: page success rate improved to 99.6% over the last 3m after fallback. Failed pages dropped to 0 in last 90s.

maria: good catch. Action items: (1) postmortem owner tess, (2) add pre-deploy smoke for notify-proxy that hits /v1/pages end-to-end, (3) add synthetic healthcheck alert for >1% page failure in 1m window, (4) follow up with pagerflow vendor to verify compatibility change in v2.4.9.

tess: agreed. I'll create the postmortem doc and list the rollback and fallback steps + timeline. Also will add the synthetic test to CI.

alex: for now pages are back and I'm getting test and alert pages. I'll stay on-call and monitor for 30m. If anything spikes I will call an on-call rollup.

incident-bot: SUMMARY: Root cause likely a notify-proxy regression in v2.4.9 causing 502s to pagerflow. Mitigation: switched to notify-backup relay and rolled back canaries to v2.4.8. Customer impact: delayed pages for some infra monitors (~11m delay reported for at least one customer ticket). Next steps: postmortem, improved smoke tests, synthetic alert. Incident owner: tess.

alex: thanks all — please paste postmortem link here when ready so I can QA the timeline.
